# Standard library signatures

<!-- Generated by tests/test_stdlib_index.rs; do not edit. -->

Every public declaration of each `std` module, one line each, so you can
check that an operation exists and what it returns before reading its
module page. The page states the contracts: ownership, allocation, error
variants, and limits. `pub` is omitted. Fields, methods, and variants are
indented under their owner. Summaries come from the
[module table](index.md#modules).

After changing a standard module, regenerate this page with
`UPDATE_STDLIB_INDEX=1 cargo test --locked --test integration test_stdlib_index::`.

## `std.actor`

Supervised actors on one thread, each with its own heap, bounded mailbox and copied messages; a trap discards only that actor's heap and files; timers, request-reply and restart. Errors: `StartError`, `Undelivered[M]`, `TimerError`, `RequestError[M]`. [Reference](actor.md).

```text
const max_heap_limit: i64 = 67108864
const max_spawns: i64 = 16
const max_capacity: i64 = 1048576
class Address
    def key(self) -> u64
class Watch
    def key(self) -> u64
class Timer
    def key(self) -> u64
    def tag(self) -> i64
class Request
    def key(self) -> u64
enum Reply[M]
    Answer(M) | TimedOut | Gone
enum TimerError
    Capacity | Range
enum RequestError[M]
    Full(M) | Gone(M) | Capacity(M)
enum Exit[E]
    # Stopped by `Context.stop`, a `Stop` request, or a spawn hook that | Failed(E) | Trapped(TrapKind)
enum TrapKind
    Memory | Index | Arithmetic | Unwrap | Other
enum Mail[M, E]
    Message(M) | Ready(Watch, Readiness) | Down(Address, i64, Exit[E]) | Stop | Timer(Timer) | Request(Request, M) | Reply(Request, Reply[M])
enum Undelivered[M]
    Full(M) | Gone(M)
enum StageError
    Allocation(AllocError) | Wait(WaitError)
enum StartError
    Unsupported | Capacity | Heaps | Mailbox
class Stats
    started: i64
    stopped: i64
    failed: i64
    trapped: i64
    restarted: i64
    delivered: i64
    full: i64
    gone: i64
    lost: i64
def supported() -> bool
def heaps_live() -> i64
def heap_bytes_used() -> i64
def heap_bytes_committed() -> i64
class Context[M, E]
    def address(self) -> Address
    def stop(self: &mut Context[M, E]) -> ()
    def heap_used(self) -> i64
    def send(self: &mut Context[M, E], to: Address, message: M) -> Result[(), Undelivered[M]]
    def stop_actor(self: &mut Context[M, E], to: Address) -> bool
    def spawn(self: &mut Context[M, E], tag: i64, limit: Positive[i64]) -> Result[Address, StartError]
    def spawn_isolated(self: &mut Context[M, E], tag: i64, limit: Positive[i64]) -> Result[Address, StartError]
    def restart(self: &mut Context[M, E], child: Address, limit: i64, window: &Duration) -> bool
    def after(self: &mut Context[M, E], delay: &Duration, tag: i64) -> Result[Timer, TimerError]
    def every(self: &mut Context[M, E], period: &Duration, tag: i64) -> Result[Timer, TimerError]
    def cancel(self: &mut Context[M, E], timer: Timer) -> bool
    def request(self: &mut Context[M, E], to: Address, message: M, timeout: &Duration) -> Result[Request, RequestError[M]]
    def reply(self: &mut Context[M, E], request: Request, message: M) -> Result[(), Undelivered[M]]
    def watch[H: Watchable](self: &mut Context[M, E], handle: &H, interest: Interest) -> Result[Watch, WaitError]
    def unwatch[H: Watchable](self: &mut Context[M, E], handle: &H) -> Result[(), WaitError]
class Stage[N, M, E]
    def shutdown(self: &mut Stage[N, M, E]) -> ()
    def start(self: &mut Stage[N, M, E], node: N, limit: Positive[i64]) -> Result[Address, StartError]
    def send(self: &mut Stage[N, M, E], to: Address, message: M) -> Result[(), Undelivered[M]]
    def stop_actor(self: &mut Stage[N, M, E], to: Address) -> bool
    def add_timers(self: &mut Stage[N, M, E], count: i64) -> Result[(), AllocError]
    def live(self) -> i64
    def stats(self) -> Stats
    def node(self, actor: Address) -> Option[&N]
    def heap_used(self, actor: Address) -> Option[i64]
    def run(self: &mut Stage[N, M, E], deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[(), WaitError]
def stage[N, M, E](capacity: i64, mailbox: i64, events: i64) -> Result[Stage[N, M, E], StageError]
```

## `std.actor.net`

TCP for actors: a listener that starts one actor per connection with admission limits, connections with bounded buffers, back-pressure and deadlines, and nonblocking connect and lookup. Errors: `NetError`, `TimerError`, `BytesError`. [Reference](actor-net.md).

```text
class Limits
    input: Positive[i64]
    output: Positive[i64]
    idle: Duration
    stall: Duration
enum Expired
    Idle | Read | Write
class Events
    mine: bool
    received: i64
    ended: bool
    writable: bool
    drained: bool
    expired: Option[Expired]
class Connection
    def start[M, E](self: &mut Connection, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), NetError | TimerError]
    def handle[M, E](self: &mut Connection, mail: &Mail[M, E], context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[Events, NetError | TimerError]
    def input(self) -> &Bytes
    def input_start(self) -> i64
    def input_stop(self) -> i64
    def available(self) -> i64
    def consume[M, E](self: &mut Connection, count: i64, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), NetError | TimerError]
    def pending(self) -> i64
    def space(self) -> i64
    def write[M, E](self: &mut Connection, source: &[u8], context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[i64, NetError | TimerError]
    def reserve(self: &mut Connection, wanted: NonNegative[i64]) -> Result[i64, NetError]
    def output(self: &mut Connection) -> &mut Bytes
    def output_stop(self) -> i64
    def commit[M, E](self: &mut Connection, count: i64, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), NetError | TimerError]
    def forward[M, E](self: &mut Connection, count: i64, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[i64, NetError | TimerError]
    def read_within[M, E](self: &mut Connection, span: &Duration, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), NetError | TimerError]
    def clear_read_deadline(self: &mut Connection) -> ()
    def shutdown_write[M, E](self: &mut Connection, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), NetError | TimerError]
    def close[M, E](self: &mut Connection, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), NetError]
    def acknowledge_now(self: &mut Connection) -> ()
    def reading(self) -> bool
    def closed(self) -> bool
    def stream(self) -> &TcpStream
def connection(stream: TcpStream, limits: &Limits) -> Result[Connection, AllocError]
enum Admission
    Pause | Refuse
class Listener
    def start[M, E](self: &mut Listener, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), NetError]
    def handle[M, E](self: &mut Listener, mail: &Mail[M, E], context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[bool, NetError]
    def accept(self) -> Result[Option[Connection], NetError | AllocError]
    def live(self) -> i64
    def refused(self) -> i64
    def tag(self) -> i64
    def local_address(self) -> Result[SocketAddress, NetError]
def listener(socket: TcpListener, limits: Limits, capacity: Positive[i64], heap: Positive[i64], tag: i64, admission: Admission) -> Result[Listener, NetError]
class Dialing
    def handle[M, E](self: &mut Dialing, mail: &Mail[M, E], context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[Option[TcpStream], NetError]
    def abandon[M, E](self: &mut Dialing, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), NetError]
def dial[M, E](address: &SocketAddress, timeout: &Duration, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[Dialing, NetError | TimerError]
class Resolving
    def handle[M, E](self: &mut Resolving, mail: &Mail[M, E], context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[Option[list[SocketAddress]], NetError]
    def abandon[M, E](self: &mut Resolving, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), NetError]
def lookup[M, E](host: &strview, port: u16, timeout: &Duration, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[Resolving, NetError | TimerError]
```

## `std.actor.tls`

TLS for actor connections: a std.tls session over a `std.actor.net` connection, with plaintext back-pressure and the session in the connection actor's heap. Errors: `TlsError`, `TimerError`. [Reference](actor-tls.md).

```text
class TlsConnection
    def start[M, E](self: &mut TlsConnection, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), TlsError | TimerError]
    def handle[M, E](self: &mut TlsConnection, mail: &Mail[M, E], context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[Events, TlsError | TimerError]
    def input(self) -> &Bytes
    def input_start(self) -> i64
    def input_stop(self) -> i64
    def available(self) -> i64
    def consume[M, E](self: &mut TlsConnection, count: i64, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), TlsError | TimerError]
    def pending(self) -> i64
    def space(self) -> i64
    def write[M, E](self: &mut TlsConnection, source: &[u8], context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[i64, TlsError | TimerError]
    def forward[M, E](self: &mut TlsConnection, count: i64, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[i64, TlsError | TimerError]
    def read_within[M, E](self: &mut TlsConnection, span: &Duration, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), TlsError | TimerError]
    def clear_read_deadline(self: &mut TlsConnection) -> ()
    def shutdown_write[M, E](self: &mut TlsConnection, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), TlsError | TimerError]
    def close[M, E](self: &mut TlsConnection, context: &mut Context[M, E]) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def established(self) -> bool
    def reading(self) -> bool
    def closed(self) -> bool
    def session(self) -> &Session
    def connection(self) -> &Connection
def over(net: Connection, session: Session, input: Positive[i64]) -> Result[TlsConnection, TlsError]
def server(net: Connection, config: &ServerConfig, input: Positive[i64]) -> Result[TlsConnection, TlsError]
def client(net: Connection, config: &ClientConfig, server_name: &strview, input: Positive[i64]) -> Result[TlsConnection, TlsError]
```

## `std.actor.http.server`

HTTP/1.1 and HTTPS on isolated connection actors, bounded request/response handlers or resumable streaming events, deadlines and draining. Errors: `ServerError`. [Reference](actor-http-server.md).

```text
enum ServerError
    InvalidConfig | AdmissionStopped | Allocation(AllocError) | Bytes(BytesError) | Http(HttpError) | Net(NetError) | Tls(TlsError) | Timer(TimerError) | Wait(WaitError) | Actor(std.actor.StartError) | Range(RangeError) | Handler
enum Notice[M]
    Message(M) | Drain | Resume | Completed | CompletedBy(Address) | Rejected
enum Event[M]
    Head(RequestHead, RequestTarget) | Body(Bytes) | Trailers(list[std.http.Header]) | End | Writable | Actor(Mail[Notice[M], ServerError]) | Message(M) | Stopping
class Config
    capacity: i64
    heap_limit: i64
    input_buffer: i64
    output_buffer: i64
    pending_output: i64
    limits: Limits
    idle_timeout: Duration
    head_timeout: Duration
    body_timeout: Duration
    write_timeout: Duration
    response_timeout: Duration
    handshake_timeout: Duration
    drain_timeout: Duration
    max_requests: Positive[i64]
class Report
    actors: Stats
    requests: u64
    rejected: u64
    protocol_errors: u64
protocol Handler[M, E]
    def receive(self: &mut Handler[M, E], event: Event[M], response: &mut Response, context: &mut Context[Notice[M], ServerError]) -> Result[(), E]
class Response
    def is_stopping(self) -> bool
    def close_after(self: &mut Response) -> ()
    def shutdown_server(self: &mut Response) -> ()
    def is_started(self) -> bool
    def is_done(self) -> bool
    def pending(self) -> i64
    def space(self) -> i64
    def start(self: &mut Response, head: ResponseHead) -> Result[(), ServerError]
    def write(self: &mut Response, source: &[u8]) -> Result[i64, ServerError]
    def finish(self: &mut Response) -> Result[(), ServerError]
    def respond(self: &mut Response, head: ResponseHead, body: &[u8]) -> Result[(), ServerError]
    def send(self: &mut Response, status: i64, content_type: &str, body: &[u8]) -> Result[(), ServerError]
    def send_text(self: &mut Response, status: i64, text: &strview) -> Result[(), ServerError]
def config() -> Config
class Node[F, H]
    def started[M](self: &mut Node[F, H], context: &mut Context[Notice[M], ServerError]) -> Result[(), ServerError]
    def receive[M](self: &mut Node[F, H], mail: Mail[Notice[M], ServerError], context: &mut Context[Notice[M], ServerError]) -> Result[(), ServerError]
    def spawn[M](self, tag: i64, child: Address, context: &mut Context[Notice[M], ServerError]) -> Result[Option[Node[F, H]], ServerError]
class Request
    head: RequestHead
    target: RequestTarget
    body: Bytes
    trailers: list[std.http.Header]
protocol RequestHandler[E]
    def handle(self: &mut RequestHandler[E], request: Request, response: &mut Response) -> Result[(), E]
def serve[F: Callable[[], Result[H, FE]], H: RequestHandler[HE], FE, HE](listener: TcpListener, factory: F, config: &Config, stop: &CancellationToken) -> Result[Report, ServerError]
def serve_tls[F: Callable[[], Result[H, FE]], H: RequestHandler[HE], FE, HE](listener: TcpListener, tls: ServerConfig, factory: F, config: &Config, stop: &CancellationToken) -> Result[Report, ServerError]
def serve_events[F: Callable[[], Result[H, FE]], H: Handler[M, HE], M, FE, HE](listener: TcpListener, factory: F, config: &Config, stop: &CancellationToken) -> Result[Report, ServerError]
def serve_tls_events[F: Callable[[], Result[H, FE]], H: Handler[M, HE], M, FE, HE](listener: TcpListener, tls: ServerConfig, factory: F, config: &Config, stop: &CancellationToken) -> Result[Report, ServerError]
```

## `std.archive`

TAR and ZIP readers and writers over `std.io`, and extraction into a new directory under explicit path, link, and size limits. Errors: `ArchiveError`. [Reference](archive.md).

```text
enum ArchiveError
    Stream(StreamError) | Io(IoError) | Fs(FsError) | Allocation(AllocError) | Corrupt | Checksum | Truncated | Unsupported | UnsafePath | Link | Special | Duplicate | Exists | Limit | Cancelled | InvalidInput
enum EntryKind
    File | Directory | Symlink | Hardlink | Other
class Entry
    name: Path
    kind: EntryKind
    size: i64
    compressed: i64
    mode: i64
    mtime: i64
    link: Path
class Policy
    max_entries: i64
    max_entry_size: i64
    max_total_size: i64
    max_ratio: i64
    max_depth: i64
    max_name: i64
    skip_links: bool
    skip_special: bool
def policy() -> Policy
class Summary
    entries: i64
    files: i64
    bytes: i64
    skipped: i64
def stream_error(error: ArchiveError) -> StreamError
class TarReader[R]
    inner: R
    def failure(self) -> Option[ArchiveError]
    def next(self: &mut TarReader[R]) -> Result[Option[Entry], ArchiveError]
    def read(self: &mut TarReader[R], buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[i64, StreamError]
def tar_reader[R](inner: R) -> Result[TarReader[R], ArchiveError]
class TarWriter[W]
    inner: W
    def add_file(self: &mut TarWriter[W], name: &Path, data: &[u8], mode: i64, mtime: i64) -> Result[(), ArchiveError]
    def add_from[S](self: &mut TarWriter[W], name: &Path, size: i64, source: &mut S, mode: i64, mtime: i64) -> Result[(), ArchiveError]
    def add_dir(self: &mut TarWriter[W], name: &Path, mode: i64, mtime: i64) -> Result[(), ArchiveError]
    def add_symlink(self: &mut TarWriter[W], name: &Path, target: &Path, mtime: i64) -> Result[(), ArchiveError]
    def finish(self: &mut TarWriter[W]) -> Result[(), ArchiveError]
def tar_writer[W](inner: W) -> Result[TarWriter[W], ArchiveError]
class ZipReader[R]
    inner: R
    def len(self) -> i64
    def entries(self) -> &list[Entry]
    def failure(self) -> Option[ArchiveError]
    def open(self: &mut ZipReader[R], index: i64) -> Result[(), ArchiveError]
    def read(self: &mut ZipReader[R], buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[i64, StreamError]
def zip_reader[R](inner: R, max_entries: NonNegative[i64]) -> Result[ZipReader[R], ArchiveError]
enum Method
    Stored | Deflate
class ZipWriter[W]
    inner: W
    def add_file(self: &mut ZipWriter[W], name: &Path, data: &[u8], method: Method, mode: i64, mtime: i64) -> Result[(), ArchiveError]
    def add_dir(self: &mut ZipWriter[W], name: &Path, mode: i64, mtime: i64) -> Result[(), ArchiveError]
    def add_symlink(self: &mut ZipWriter[W], name: &Path, target: &Path, mtime: i64) -> Result[(), ArchiveError]
    def finish(self: &mut ZipWriter[W]) -> Result[(), ArchiveError]
def zip_writer[W](inner: W) -> Result[ZipWriter[W], ArchiveError]
def extract_tar[R](archive: &mut TarReader[R], parent: &Root, destination: &Path, policy: &Policy, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[Summary, ArchiveError]
def extract_zip[R](archive: &mut ZipReader[R], parent: &Root, destination: &Path, policy: &Policy, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[Summary, ArchiveError]
```

## `std.atomic`

Inline atomic integers and booleans with compile-time checked orderings, and fences. [Reference](atomic.md).

Compiler-provided: `Atomic`, `fence`. Their signatures are on the reference page.

```text
enum Ordering
    Relaxed | Release | Acquire | AcqRel | SeqCst
```

## `std.bytes`

```text

    InvalidUtf8 | Allocation(AllocError)

    def len(self) -> i64

    def pop(self: &mut Bytes) -> Option[u8]
    def reserve(self: &mut Bytes, additional: i64) -> Result[(), AllocError]
    def resize(self: &mut Bytes, count: i64, fill: u8) -> Result[(), AllocError]
    def truncate(self: &mut Bytes, count: i64) -> ()
    def clear(self: &mut Bytes) -> ()
    def fill(self: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64, value: u8) -> ()
    def extend(self: &mut Bytes, source: &[u8]) -> Result[(), AllocError]

    def copy(self) -> Result[Bytes, AllocError]
    def find(self, value: u8, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Option[i64]
    def find_in(self, set: &[u8], start: i64, stop: i64) -> Option[i64]
```

## `std.cache.lru`

Fixed-capacity caches that evict the least recently used entry, with constant-time lookup, promotion and eviction. Errors: `AllocError`. [Reference](cache-lru.md).

```text
class LruCache[K, V]
    def __init__(self, capacity: i64) -> Result[(), AllocError]
    def capacity(self) -> i64
    def len(self) -> i64
    def is_empty(self) -> bool
    def contains(self, key: &K) -> bool
    def get(self: &mut LruCache[K, V], key: &K) -> Option[V]
    def peek(self, key: &K) -> Option[V]
    def get_ref(self: &mut LruCache[K, V], key: &K) -> Option[&V]
    def get_mut(self: &mut LruCache[K, V], key: &K) -> Option[&mut V]
    def peek_ref(self, key: &K) -> Option[&V]
    def peek_mut(self: &mut LruCache[K, V], key: &K) -> Option[&mut V]
    def promote(self: &mut LruCache[K, V], key: &K) -> bool
    def put(self: &mut LruCache[K, V], key: K, value: V) -> Result[Option[(K, V)], AllocError]
    def remove(self: &mut LruCache[K, V], key: &K) -> Option[V]
    def pop_lru(self: &mut LruCache[K, V]) -> Option[(K, V)]
    def clear(self: &mut LruCache[K, V]) -> ()
```

## `std.db.kv`

Ordered byte-key maps, atomic transactions and bounded scans over a versioned SQLite store. Errors: `KvError`. [Reference](kv.md).

```text
enum Mode
    ReadOnly | ReadWrite | Create
enum KvError
    Database(sqlite.DbError) | Allocation(AllocError) | InvalidName | ForeignDatabase | UnsupportedVersion(i64)
const format_version: i64 = 1
class Entry
    key: Bytes
    value: Bytes
class Scan
    def next(self: &mut Scan) -> Result[Option[Entry], KvError]
class Transaction
    def commit(self: &mut Transaction) -> Result[(), KvError]
    def rollback(self: &mut Transaction) -> Result[(), KvError]
class Store
    def begin(self: &mut Store, immediate: bool = True) -> Result[Transaction, KvError]
    def set_busy_timeout(self: &mut Store, budget: &Duration) -> Result[(), KvError]
    def close(self: &mut Store) -> Result[(), KvError]
    def put(self: &mut Store, table: &strview, key: &[u8], value: &[u8]) -> Result[(), KvError]
    def get(self: &mut Store, table: &strview, key: &[u8]) -> Result[Option[Bytes], KvError]
    def contains(self: &mut Store, table: &strview, key: &[u8]) -> Result[bool, KvError]
    def remove(self: &mut Store, table: &strview, key: &[u8]) -> Result[bool, KvError]
    def clear(self: &mut Store, table: &strview) -> Result[i64, KvError]
    def len(self: &mut Store, table: &strview) -> Result[i64, KvError]
    def scan(self: &mut Store, table: &strview, start: &[u8], stop: &[u8], max_rows: NonNegative[i64], after: bool = False, reverse: bool = False) -> Result[Scan, KvError]
    def scan_all(self: &mut Store, table: &strview, max_rows: NonNegative[i64], reverse: bool = False) -> Result[Scan, KvError]
def connect(path: &strview, mode: Mode = Mode.Create, max_length: i64 = 1048576) -> Result[Store, KvError]
def memory(max_length: i64 = 1048576) -> Result[Store, KvError]
```

## `std.db.sqlite`

SQLite databases through prepared statements with typed parameters and reads, owned transactions that roll back on drop, and an explicit value-size limit. Errors: `DbError`. [Reference](sqlite.md).

```text
enum Mode
    ReadOnly | ReadWrite | Create
enum Begin
    Deferred | Immediate | Exclusive
enum ValueType
    Integer | Real | Text | Blob | Null
class SqliteError
    code: i64
    message: str
    def primary(self) -> i64
enum DbError
    Sqlite(SqliteError) | Closed | InUse | EmptySql | TrailingSql | TransactionActive | TransactionFinished | InvalidPath | InvalidExtensionEntry | OutOfRange | NoRow | TypeMismatch(ValueType) | TooLarge | InvalidUtf8 | Allocation(AllocError)
const error: i64 = 1
const busy: i64 = 5
const locked: i64 = 6
const read_only: i64 = 8
const cant_open: i64 = 14
const constraint: i64 = 19
const mismatch: i64 = 20
const min_length_limit: i64 = 1024
const max_length_limit: i64 = 1000000000
class Connection
    def execute(self: &mut Connection, sql: &strview) -> Result[(), DbError]
    def prepare(self: &mut Connection, sql: &strview) -> Result[Statement, DbError]
    def begin(self: &mut Connection, mode: Begin) -> Result[Transaction, DbError]
    def changes(self) -> i64
    def last_insert_rowid(self) -> i64
    def set_busy_timeout(self: &mut Connection, budget: &Duration) -> Result[(), DbError]
    def load_extension(self: &mut Connection, path: &strview, entrypoint: &strview = "") -> Result[(), DbError]
    def close(self: &mut Connection) -> Result[(), DbError]
def connect(path: &strview, mode: Mode, max_length: i64) -> Result[Connection, DbError]
def memory(max_length: i64) -> Result[Connection, DbError]
class Statement
    def parameter_count(self) -> i64
    def parameter_index(self, name: &strview) -> Result[i64, DbError]
    def bind_null(self: &mut Statement, index: i64) -> Result[(), DbError]
    def bind_integer(self: &mut Statement, index: i64, value: i64) -> Result[(), DbError]
    def bind_real(self: &mut Statement, index: i64, value: f64) -> Result[(), DbError]
    def bind_text(self: &mut Statement, index: i64, value: &strview) -> Result[(), DbError]
    def bind_blob(self: &mut Statement, index: i64, value: &[u8]) -> Result[(), DbError]
    def clear_bindings(self: &mut Statement) -> Result[(), DbError]
    def step(self: &mut Statement) -> Result[bool, DbError]
    def reset(self: &mut Statement) -> ()
    def run(self: &mut Statement) -> Result[(), DbError]
    def column_count(self) -> i64
    def column_name(self, column: i64) -> Result[str, DbError]
    def kind(self, column: i64) -> Result[ValueType, DbError]
    def is_null(self, column: i64) -> Result[bool, DbError]
    def integer(self, column: i64) -> Result[i64, DbError]
    def real(self, column: i64) -> Result[f64, DbError]
    def text(self, column: i64) -> Result[str, DbError]
    def blob(self, column: i64) -> Result[Bytes, DbError]
    def optional_integer(self, column: i64) -> Result[Option[i64], DbError]
    def optional_real(self, column: i64) -> Result[Option[f64], DbError]
    def optional_text(self, column: i64) -> Result[Option[str], DbError]
    def optional_blob(self, column: i64) -> Result[Option[Bytes], DbError]
class Transaction
    def commit(self: &mut Transaction) -> Result[(), DbError]
    def rollback(self: &mut Transaction) -> Result[(), DbError]
```

## `std.deque`

```text
class Deque[T]
    def __init__(self) -> Result[(), AllocError]
    def len(self) -> i64
    def is_empty(self) -> bool
    def append(self: &mut Deque[T], value: T) -> Result[(), AllocError]
    def appendleft(self: &mut Deque[T], value: T) -> Result[(), AllocError]
    def pop(self: &mut Deque[T]) -> Option[T]
    def popleft(self: &mut Deque[T]) -> Option[T]
    def clear(self: &mut Deque[T]) -> ()
```

## `std.diff`

Line, word, character, byte, and list differences as edit operations, with Myers and patience algorithms and unified-diff output. Errors: `AllocError`. [Reference](diff.md).

```text
enum Algorithm
    Myers | Patience
enum Kind
    Equal | Delete | Insert
class Op
    kind: Kind
    old_start: i64
    old_end: i64
    new_start: i64
    new_end: i64
    def old_len(self) -> Result[i64, OverflowError[i64]]
    def new_len(self) -> Result[i64, OverflowError[i64]]
    def is_equal(self) -> bool
def diff[T](old: &list[T], new: &list[T], algorithm: Algorithm = Algorithm.Myers, max_cost: Option[i64] = Nothing) -> Result[list[Op], AllocError]
def diff_bytes(old: &[u8], new: &[u8], algorithm: Algorithm = Algorithm.Myers, max_cost: Option[i64] = Nothing) -> Result[list[Op], AllocError]
class TextDiff
    def ops(self) -> &list[Op]
    def old_tokens(self) -> &list[str]
    def new_tokens(self) -> &list[str]
    def has_changes(self) -> bool
    def unified(self, context: i64, old_name: &strview, new_name: &strview) -> Result[str, AllocError]
def lines(old: &strview, new: &strview, algorithm: Algorithm = Algorithm.Myers, max_cost: Option[i64] = Nothing) -> Result[TextDiff, AllocError]
def words(old: &strview, new: &strview, algorithm: Algorithm = Algorithm.Myers, max_cost: Option[i64] = Nothing) -> Result[TextDiff, AllocError]
def chars(old: &strview, new: &strview, algorithm: Algorithm = Algorithm.Myers, max_cost: Option[i64] = Nothing) -> Result[TextDiff, AllocError]
```

```text
    def set_content_type(self: &mut RefusalResponse, value: str) -> Result[(), RefusalError]

    def set_fallback(self: &mut Router[R], route: Option[R]) -> ()

    def set_trailing_slash(self: &mut Router[R], policy: TrailingSlash) -> ()

def router[R]() -> Result[Router[R], ServerError]
class Conn[T]

    def start(self: &mut Exchange[T], head: ResponseHead) -> Result[(), HttpError]

    def end(self: &mut Exchange[T]) -> Result[(), HttpError]

    def detach(self: &mut Exchange[T], head: ResponseHead) -> Result[T, HttpError]
def reason(status: i64) -> str
def serve_connection[T: Transport, R, E, H: Handler[T, R, E]](stream: T, router: &Router[R], handler: &H, config: &Config, stop: &CancellationToken, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Report
```

## `std.io`

Partial-progress byte stream contracts, retry helpers, fixed-capacity buffering, file and process-stream adapters, and checked sequential binary fields in an owned memory cursor. Errors: `StreamError`, `Partial`, `CopyError`, `CloseError`, `BinaryError`. [Reference](io.md).

```text
enum StreamError
    Interrupted | UnexpectedEof | WriteZero | OutOfRange | InvalidProgress | Io(IoError) | Allocation(AllocError)

    completed: i64

enum CloseError

    def read(self: &mut Reader, buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[i64, StreamError]
protocol Writer
    def write(self: &mut Writer, source: &[u8]) -> Result[i64, StreamError]
    def flush(self: &mut Writer) -> Result[(), StreamError]
protocol Seeker
    def seek(self: &mut Seeker, target: SeekFrom) -> Result[i64, StreamError]
protocol Closer
    def close(self: &mut Closer) -> Result[(), StreamError]
def classify(error: IoError) -> StreamError
def read_exact[R: Reader](reader: &mut R, buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[(), Partial]
def write_all[W: Writer](writer: &mut W, source: &[u8]) -> Result[(), Partial]
def read_up_to[R: Reader](reader: &mut R, out: &mut Bytes, limit: NonNegative[i64]) -> Result[i64, Partial]

class BufReader[R]
    inner: R
    def capacity(self) -> i64
    def buffered(self) -> i64
    def read(self: &mut BufReader[R], buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[i64, StreamError]
    def read_until(self: &mut BufReader[R], delimiter: u8, out: &mut Bytes, limit: Positive[i64]) -> Result[i64, StreamError]
def buffered_reader[R](inner: R, capacity: Positive[i64]) -> Result[BufReader[R], StreamError]
def seek_reader[R: Seeker](reader: &mut BufReader[R], target: SeekFrom) -> Result[i64, StreamError]
class BufWriter[W]

    def write_bytes(self: &mut Cursor, source: &[u8], max_bytes: i64 = 1048576) -> Result[(), BinaryError]
    def read_u8(self: &mut Cursor) -> Result[u8, BinaryError]
    def write_u8(self: &mut Cursor, value: u8, max_bytes: i64 = 1048576) -> Result[(), BinaryError]
    def read_i8(self: &mut Cursor) -> Result[i8, BinaryError]
    def write_i8(self: &mut Cursor, value: i8, max_bytes: i64 = 1048576) -> Result[(), BinaryError]

    def write_u16(self: &mut Cursor, value: u16, order: Endian, max_bytes: i64 = 1048576) -> Result[(), BinaryError]

    def write_i16(self: &mut Cursor, value: i16, order: Endian, max_bytes: i64 = 1048576) -> Result[(), BinaryError]
    def read_u32(self: &mut Cursor, order: Endian) -> Result[u32, BinaryError]
    def write_u32(self: &mut Cursor, value: u32, order: Endian, max_bytes: i64 = 1048576) -> Result[(), BinaryError]
    def read_i32(self: &mut Cursor, order: Endian) -> Result[i32, BinaryError]
    def write_i32(self: &mut Cursor, value: i32, order: Endian, max_bytes: i64 = 1048576) -> Result[(), BinaryError]

    def write(self: &mut Cursor, source: &[u8]) -> Result[i64, StreamError]
```

## `std.io.typed`

Byte stream protocols that carry a caller-chosen error type, buffering, adapters for `std.io` streams, and exact read, write, and copy helpers. Errors: `StepError[E]`, `Partial[E]`, `CopyFailure[R, W]`. [Reference](io-typed.md).

```text
enum StepError[E]
    Interrupted | Source(E)
class LegacyReader[R]
    def read(self: &mut LegacyReader[R], buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[i64, StepError[StreamError]]
def reader[R: std.io.Reader](inner: R) -> LegacyReader[R]
def unwrap_reader[R](reader: LegacyReader[R]) -> R
class LegacyWriter[W]
    def write(self: &mut LegacyWriter[W], buffer: &[u8]) -> Result[i64, StepError[StreamError]]
def writer[W: std.io.Writer](inner: W) -> LegacyWriter[W]
def unwrap_writer[W](writer: LegacyWriter[W]) -> W
protocol Reader[E]
    def read(self: &mut Reader[E], buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[i64, StepError[E]]
protocol Writer[E]
    def write(self: &mut Writer[E], buffer: &[u8]) -> Result[i64, StepError[E]]
enum ReadFailure[E]
    Source(E) | UnexpectedEof | InvalidProgress | OutOfRange
class BufReader[E, R]
    inner: R
    def capacity(self) -> i64
    def buffered(self) -> i64
    def read(self: &mut BufReader[E, R], buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[i64, StepError[ReadFailure[E]]]
def buffered_reader[E, R: Reader[E]](inner: R, capacity: Positive[i64]) -> Result[BufReader[E, R], StreamError]
enum WriteFailure[E]
    Source(E) | WriteZero | InvalidProgress
class Partial[E]
    completed: i64
    cause: E
enum CopyFailure[R, W]
    Read(i64, ReadFailure[R]) | Write(i64, WriteFailure[W])
def within(start: i64, stop: i64, size: i64) -> bool
def read_exact[E, R: Reader[E]](reader: &mut R, buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[(), Partial[ReadFailure[E]]]
def write_all[E, W: Writer[E]](writer: &mut W, buffer: &[u8]) -> Result[(), Partial[WriteFailure[E]]]
def copy_all[E, G, R: Reader[E], W: Writer[G]](reader: &mut R, writer: &mut W, scratch: &mut Bytes) -> Result[i64, CopyFailure[E, G]]
```

## `std.serial`

Format-neutral typed codecs, derived or handwritten class/enum hooks, canonical bytes, and typed error paths. Errors: `SerialError[E]`. [Reference](serial.md).

```text
enum Kind
    Null | Boolean | Integer | Number | Text | Array | Object | DateTime | Variant | Key | End
    def format[W](self, output: &mut Formatter[W]) -> Result[(), FormatError]
enum Fault
    UnexpectedKind | KindMismatch(Kind, Kind) | MissingField(str) | DuplicateField(str) | UnknownField(str) | UnknownVariant(str) | OutOfRange | WrongLength(i64, i64) | DuplicateElement | Unrepresentable | InvalidBase64(std.encoding.EncodingError) | StackLimit
    def format[W](self, output: &mut Formatter[W]) -> Result[(), FormatError]
enum Step
    Field(str) | Index(i64) | Key(str) | Variant(str)
class SerialError[E]
    cause: E
    path: Option[list[Step]]
    complete: bool
    def source_offset(self) -> Option[i64]
    def format[W](self, output: &mut Formatter[W]) -> Result[(), FormatError]
    def at(self: SerialError[E], step: Step) -> SerialError[E]
def error[E](cause: E) -> SerialError[E]
def wrap[T, E](result: Result[T, E]) -> Result[T, SerialError[E]]
def at[T, E](result: Result[T, SerialError[E]], step: Step) -> Result[T, SerialError[E]]
protocol Encoder[E]
    def reject(self, fault: Fault) -> E
    def allocation(self, cause: AllocError) -> E
    def null(self: &mut Encoder) -> Result[(), E]
    def boolean(self: &mut Encoder, value: bool) -> Result[(), E]
    def integer(self: &mut Encoder, value: i64) -> Result[(), E]
    def unsigned(self: &mut Encoder, value: u64) -> Result[(), E]
    def decimal(self: &mut Encoder, value: f64) -> Result[(), E]
    def text(self: &mut Encoder, value: &str) -> Result[(), E]
    def start_array(self: &mut Encoder) -> Result[(), E]
    def end_array(self: &mut Encoder) -> Result[(), E]
    def start_object(self: &mut Encoder) -> Result[(), E]
    def key(self: &mut Encoder, name: &str) -> Result[(), E]
    def field(self: &mut Encoder, name: &str) -> Result[(), E]
    def end_object(self: &mut Encoder) -> Result[(), E]
protocol Decoder[E]
    def variant(self: &mut Decoder) -> Result[(str, bool), E]
    def null(self: &mut Decoder) -> Result[bool, E]
    def boolean(self: &mut Decoder) -> Result[bool, E]
    def integer(self: &mut Decoder) -> Result[i64, E]
    def unsigned(self: &mut Decoder) -> Result[u64, E]
    def decimal(self: &mut Decoder) -> Result[f64, E]
    def text(self: &mut Decoder) -> Result[str, E]
    def start_array(self: &mut Decoder) -> Result[(), E]
    def next_element(self: &mut Decoder) -> Result[bool, E]
    def start_object(self: &mut Decoder) -> Result[(), E]
    def next_key(self: &mut Decoder) -> Result[Option[str], E]
    def unknown_key(self: &mut Decoder, name: &str) -> Result[(), E]
    def reject(self, fault: Fault) -> E
    def allocation(self, cause: AllocError) -> E
def encode[T, E, S: Encoder[E]](value: &T, out: &mut S) -> Result[(), SerialError[E]]
def decode[T, E, D: Decoder[E]](source: &mut D) -> Result[T, SerialError[E]]
def absent[T, E, D: Decoder[E]](source: &D, name: &str) -> Result[T, SerialError[E]]
enum UnknownFields
    Reject | Ignore
def allocated[T, E, D: Decoder[E]](result: Result[T, AllocError], source: &D) -> Result[T, SerialError[E]]
def encode_bytes[E, S: Encoder[E]](value: &[u8], out: &mut S) -> Result[(), SerialError[E]]
def decode_bytes[E, D: Decoder[E]](source: &mut D) -> Result[Bytes, SerialError[E]]
def read_field[T, E, D: Decoder[E]](slot: &mut Option[T], source: &mut D, name: &str) -> Result[(), SerialError[E]]
def require_field[T, E, D: Decoder[E]](slot: &mut Option[T], source: &D, name: &str) -> Result[T, SerialError[E]]
def constructed[T, E, D: Decoder[E]](value: Result[T, Fault], source: &D) -> Result[T, SerialError[E]]
def constructed_or_allocated[T, E, D: Decoder[E]](value: Result[T, AllocError | Fault], source: &D) -> Result[T, SerialError[E]]
def constructed_in[X, T, E, D: Decoder[E]](value: Result[T, X], source: &D) -> Result[T, SerialError[E]]
```

```text

enum Claim

    Malformed | NotObject | TooLarge | UnsupportedAlgorithm | AlgorithmMismatch | CriticalHeader | InvalidSignature | Expired | NotYetValid | MissingClaim(Claim) | InvalidClaim(Claim) | WrongIssuer | WrongAudience | InvalidKey | InvalidValidation | RandomFailure | Allocation(AllocError)
    def format[W](self, output: &mut Formatter[W]) -> Result[(), FormatError]
class SigningKey
    def algorithm(self) -> Algorithm
    def verifying_key(self) -> Result[VerifyingKey, JwtError]

    def algorithm(self) -> Algorithm
def hmac_signing_key(algorithm: Algorithm, secret: &[u8]) -> Result[SigningKey, JwtError]
def hmac_verifying_key(algorithm: Algorithm, secret: &[u8]) -> Result[VerifyingKey, JwtError]
def rsa_signing_key(algorithm: Algorithm, key: RsaPrivateKey) -> Result[SigningKey, JwtError]
def rsa_verifying_key(algorithm: Algorithm, key: RsaPublicKey) -> Result[VerifyingKey, JwtError]
def es256_signing_key(key: P256PrivateKey) -> SigningKey
def es256_verifying_key(key: P256PublicKey) -> VerifyingKey
def ed25519_signing_key(seed: &[u8]) -> Result[SigningKey, JwtError]
def ed25519_verifying_key(public_key: &[u8]) -> Result[VerifyingKey, JwtError]
const default_max_size: i64 = 8192
const max_leeway: i64 = 86400
const max_token_size: i64 = 1048576
class Validation
    now: Timestamp
    leeway: Duration
    require_expiry: bool
    issuer: Option[str]
    audience: Option[str]
    max_size: Positive[i64]
def validation(now: &Timestamp) -> Validation
class Header
    algorithm: Algorithm
    key_id: Option[str]
    token_type: Option[str]
class Token
    header: Header
    claims: list[Member]
def decode_header(token: &strview, max_size: Positive[i64] = 8192) -> Result[Header, JwtError]
def verify(token: &strview, key: &VerifyingKey, rules: &Validation) -> Result[Token, JwtError]
def sign(key: &SigningKey, claims: &Json, key_id: Option[str] = Nothing) -> Result[str, JwtError]
```

```text
    def shuffle[T](self: &mut Rng, items: &mut list[T]) -> ()
```

## `std.ready`

Readiness waits on pipes and other handles, bounded by a deadline and a cancellation token. Errors: `WaitError`. [Reference](ready.md).

```text
enum Interest
    Read | Write | ReadWrite
class Readiness
    readable: bool
    writable: bool
    hangup: bool
    error: bool
enum WaitError
    TimedOut | Cancelled | Stream(StreamError)
def wait_now(file: &File, interest: Interest) -> Result[Readiness, WaitError]
def wait_until(file: &File, interest: Interest, deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[Readiness, WaitError]
def wait(file: &File, interest: Interest, deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[Readiness, WaitError]
def read_before(stream: &mut FileStream, buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64, deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[i64, WaitError]
def write_before(stream: &mut FileStream, source: &[u8], deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[i64, WaitError]
protocol Watchable
    def descriptor(self) -> &File
class Event
    key: u64
    readiness: Readiness
class Selector
    def watch(self: &mut Selector, file: &File, key: u64, interest: Interest) -> Result[(), WaitError]
    def unwatch(self: &mut Selector, file: &File) -> Result[(), WaitError]
    def wait(self: &mut Selector, deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[i64, WaitError]
    def event(self, index: i64) -> Result[Event, WaitError]
    def close(self: &mut Selector) -> Result[(), WaitError]
def selector(capacity: i64) -> Result[Selector, WaitError]
```

```text
    max_work: NonNegative[i64]

class Match

class Captures

    def name(self, name: &strview) -> Option[Match]
class Cursor
class Regex
    def group_count(self) -> i64
    def group_index(self, name: &strview) -> Option[i64]
    def instructions(self) -> i64

    def find(self, text: &strview) -> Result[Option[Match], RegexError]
    def find_at(self, text: &strview, start: i64) -> Result[Option[Match], RegexError]
    def find_bytes(self, data: &[u8], start: i64) -> Result[Option[Match], RegexError]
    def captures(self, text: &strview) -> Result[Option[Captures], RegexError]
    def captures_at(self, text: &strview, start: i64) -> Result[Option[Captures], RegexError]
    def captures_bytes(self, data: &[u8], start: i64) -> Result[Option[Captures], RegexError]
    def cursor(self) -> Result[Cursor, RegexError]
    def next_match(self, text: &strview, cursor: &mut Cursor) -> Result[Option[Match], RegexError]
    def next_match_bytes(self, data: &[u8], cursor: &mut Cursor) -> Result[Option[Match], RegexError]
    def find_all(self, text: &strview, max_matches: i64) -> Result[list[Match], RegexError]
    def find_all_bytes(self, data: &[u8], max_matches: i64) -> Result[list[Match], RegexError]

    def replace(self, text: &strview, template: &strview, max_bytes: i64) -> Result[str, RegexError]
    def replace_all(self, text: &strview, template: &strview, max_bytes: i64) -> Result[str, RegexError]
def compile(pattern: &str, bounds: &Limits) -> Result[Regex, RegexError]
```

```text
    def __mul__(self, rhs: &Matrix) -> Result[Matrix, LinalgError]

class Lu

def matrix(rows: i64, cols: i64, values: &list[f64]) -> Result[Matrix, LinalgError]
```

## `std.sync`

Cancellation tokens, `Mutex`, typed deadline waits, pool result collection. Errors: `AllocError`. [Reference](sync.md).

Compiler-provided: `CancellationToken`. Their signatures are on the reference page.

```text
class Mutex[T]
    def __init__(self, value: T) -> ()
enum LockError
    WouldBlock | TimedOut | Cancelled
enum WaitError
    TimedOut | Cancelled | Disconnected
enum SendBeforeError[T]
    TimedOut(T) | Cancelled(T) | Disconnected(T)
def recv_before[T](receiver: &Receiver[T], deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[T, WaitError]
def send_before[T](sender: &Sender[T], value: T, deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[(), SendBeforeError[T]]
def future_before[T](future: &Future[T], deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[(), WaitError]
def cancelled_before(token: &CancellationToken, deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[(), WaitError]
def select_recv_before[A, B](first: &Receiver[A], second: &Receiver[B], deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[Selected[A, B], WaitError]
class Completions[T]
    def __init__(self, capacity: Positive[i64]) -> Result[(), AllocError]
    def len(self) -> i64
    def is_empty(self) -> bool
    def is_full(self) -> bool
    def capacity(self) -> i64
    def submit[F: OnceCallable[[], T]](self: &mut Completions[T], pool: &ThreadPoolExecutor, job: F) -> Result[Option[Result[T, FutureError]], SubmitError[F]]
    def next_now(self: &mut Completions[T]) -> Option[Result[T, FutureError]]
    def next(self: &mut Completions[T]) -> Option[Result[T, FutureError]]
    def next_before(self: &mut Completions[T], deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[Option[Result[T, FutureError]], WaitError]
    def next_or_recv_before[M](self: &mut Completions[T], receiver: &Receiver[M], deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[Selected[Result[T, FutureError], M], WaitError]
    def cancel_queued(self) -> i64
```

## `std.thread`

Explicit scoped thread and owned-job imports. Errors: `ThreadError`, `SpawnError[F]`. [Reference](thread.md).

Compiler-provided: `spawn`, `ThreadError`, `SpawnError`. Their signatures are on the reference page.

## `std.time`

Checked durations, monotonic instants and deadlines, wall timestamps, and sleep. Errors: `RangeError`. [Reference](time.md).

```text
class Duration
    def as_nanoseconds(self) -> u64
    def as_microseconds(self) -> u64
    def as_milliseconds(self) -> u64
    def as_seconds(self) -> u64
    def as_timeout_ms(self) -> u64
    def is_zero(self) -> bool
    def checked_add(self, other: &Duration) -> Result[Duration, RangeError]
    def checked_sub(self, other: &Duration) -> Result[Duration, RangeError]
    def saturating_sub(self, other: &Duration) -> Duration
    def checked_mul(self, factor: u64) -> Result[Duration, RangeError]
def nanoseconds(count: u64) -> Duration
def microseconds(count: u32) -> Duration
def milliseconds(count: u32) -> Duration
def seconds(count: u32) -> Duration
class Instant
    def checked_add(self, span: &Duration) -> Result[Instant, RangeError]
    def duration_since(self, earlier: &Instant) -> Result[Duration, RangeError]
    def saturating_duration_since(self, earlier: &Instant) -> Duration
def monotonic_now() -> Instant
def instant_at(nanoseconds_after_origin: u64) -> Instant
protocol Clock
    def now(self) -> Instant
class MonotonicClock
    def now(self) -> Instant
def monotonic_clock() -> MonotonicClock
class Deadline
    def expired(self, now: &Instant) -> bool
    def remaining(self, now: &Instant) -> Duration
def deadline_at(at: &Instant) -> Deadline
def deadline_after(start: &Instant, budget: &Duration) -> Result[Deadline, RangeError]
class Timestamp
    seconds: i64
    nanoseconds: u32
    def duration_since(self, earlier: &Timestamp) -> Result[Duration, RangeError]
    def checked_add(self, span: &Duration) -> Result[Timestamp, RangeError]
def wall_now() -> Timestamp
def sleep(span: &Duration) -> ()
def sleep_until(deadline: &Deadline) -> ()
```

## `std.tls`

TLS 1.2 and 1.3 client and server streams over `std.net` TCP, with verified certificates, client certificates, ALPN, deadlines, and cancellation. Errors: `TlsError`. [Reference](tls.md).

```text
enum TlsError
    Net(NetError) | UntrustedCertificate | ExpiredCertificate | WrongHost | InvalidCertificate | Rejected | Protocol | Truncated | InvalidName | InvalidConfiguration | NoTrustRoots | Closed | Allocation(AllocError) | RevokedCertificate | CertificateRequired | Incompatible

    Tls12 | Tls13

enum ClientCertificates
    Required | Optional
class TrustRoots
    def len(self) -> i64
def roots_from_pem(pem: &strview) -> Result[TrustRoots, TlsError]
def system_roots() -> Result[TrustRoots, TlsError]
class ClientConfig
class ServerConfig
class ClientBuilder
    def certificate(self: &mut ClientBuilder, chain_pem: &strview, key_pem: &strview) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def application_protocol(self: &mut ClientBuilder, name: &strview) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def minimum_version(self: &mut ClientBuilder, version: TlsVersion) -> ()
    def cipher_suite(self: &mut ClientBuilder, suite: CipherSuite) -> ()
    def revocation_list(self: &mut ClientBuilder, crl_pem: &strview) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def build(self) -> Result[ClientConfig, TlsError]
def client_builder(roots: &TrustRoots) -> Result[ClientBuilder, TlsError]
def client_config(roots: &TrustRoots) -> Result[ClientConfig, TlsError]
class ServerBuilder
    def certificate(self: &mut ServerBuilder, chain_pem: &strview, key_pem: &strview) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def verify_clients(self: &mut ServerBuilder, roots: &TrustRoots, certificates: ClientCertificates) -> ()
    def application_protocol(self: &mut ServerBuilder, name: &strview) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def minimum_version(self: &mut ServerBuilder, version: TlsVersion) -> ()
    def cipher_suite(self: &mut ServerBuilder, suite: CipherSuite) -> ()
    def revocation_list(self: &mut ServerBuilder, crl_pem: &strview) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def build(self) -> Result[ServerConfig, TlsError]
def server_builder(chain_pem: &strview, key_pem: &strview) -> Result[ServerBuilder, TlsError]
def server_config(chain_pem: &strview, key_pem: &strview) -> Result[ServerConfig, TlsError]
class TlsStream
    def handshake_before(self: &mut TlsStream, deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def try_handshake(self: &mut TlsStream) -> Result[bool, TlsError]
    def try_flush(self: &mut TlsStream) -> Result[bool, TlsError]
    def try_read(self: &mut TlsStream, buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[Option[i64], TlsError]
    def try_write(self: &mut TlsStream, source: &[u8]) -> Result[Option[i64], TlsError]
    def interest(self) -> Interest
    def watch(self, selector: &mut Selector, key: u64, interest: Interest) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def unwatch(self, selector: &mut Selector) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def read_before(self: &mut TlsStream, buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64, deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[i64, TlsError]
    def write_before(self: &mut TlsStream, source: &[u8], deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[i64, TlsError]
    def write_all_before(self: &mut TlsStream, source: &[u8], deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def close_before(self: &mut TlsStream, deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def shutdown(self: &mut TlsStream, direction: Shutdown) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def read(self: &mut TlsStream, buffer: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[i64, StreamError]
    def write(self: &mut TlsStream, source: &[u8]) -> Result[i64, StreamError]
    def flush(self: &mut TlsStream) -> Result[(), StreamError]
    def close(self: &mut TlsStream) -> Result[(), StreamError]
    def application_protocol(self) -> Result[Option[str], TlsError]
    def server_name(self) -> Result[Option[str], TlsError]

    def version(self) -> Option[TlsVersion]
    def cipher_suite(self) -> Option[CipherSuite]
def start_connect(tcp: TcpStream, config: &ClientConfig, server_name: &strview) -> Result[TlsStream, TlsError]
def start_accept(tcp: TcpStream, config: &ServerConfig) -> Result[TlsStream, TlsError]

def accept(tcp: TcpStream, config: &ServerConfig, deadline: &Deadline, cancel: &CancellationToken) -> Result[TlsStream, TlsError]
class Session
    def feed(self: &mut Session, source: &[u8]) -> Result[i64, TlsError]
    def feed_end(self: &mut Session) -> Result[(), TlsError]
    def take(self: &mut Session, target: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[i64, TlsError]
    def read(self: &mut Session, target: &mut Bytes, start: i64, stop: i64) -> Result[Option[i64], TlsError]
    def write(self: &mut Session, source: &[u8]) -> Result[i64, TlsError]
    def close(self: &mut Session) -> ()
    def handshaking(self) -> bool
    def wants_write(self) -> bool
    def wants_read(self) -> bool
    def application_protocol(self) -> Result[Option[str], TlsError]
    def server_name(self) -> Result[Option[str], TlsError]
    def peer_certificate(self) -> Result[Option[Bytes], TlsError]
    def version(self) -> Option[TlsVersion]
    def cipher_suite(self) -> Option[CipherSuite]
def client_session(config: &ClientConfig, server_name: &strview) -> Result[Session, TlsError]
def server_session(config: &ServerConfig) -> Result[Session, TlsError]
```

## `std.toml`

```text
enum TomlFault
    UnexpectedByte | UnexpectedEnd | InvalidUtf8 | ControlCharacter | InvalidEscape | InvalidNumber | NumberOutOfRange | InvalidDateTime | DuplicateKey | DuplicateTable | KeyConflict | DepthExceeded | InputTooLarge | OutputTooLarge | NotATable | InvalidState | Serialization(std.serial.Fault) | Stream(StreamError) | Allocation(AllocError)

    max_input: NonNegative[i64]
    max_output: NonNegative[i64]

    OffsetDateTime | LocalDateTime | LocalDate | LocalTime

    year: i64
    month: i64
    day: i64
    hour: i64
    minute: i64
    second: i64
    nanosecond: i64
    offset_minutes: i64
enum Toml
    Bool(bool) | Int(i64) | Float(f64) | Text(str) | DateTime(DateTime) | Array(list[Toml]) | Table(list[Entry])
class Entry
    key: str
    value: Toml
def limits() -> Limits
def parse(source: &[u8], bounds: &Limits) -> Result[Toml, TomlError]

def encode(value: &Toml, bounds: &Limits) -> Result[Bytes, TomlError]
def encode_text(value: &Toml, bounds: &Limits) -> Result[str, TomlError]
def write_value[W: Writer](writer: &mut W, value: &Toml, bounds: &Limits) -> Result[(), TomlError]
class Document
    def text(self) -> Result[str, TomlError]
    def get(self, path: &list[str]) -> Result[Option[Toml], TomlError]
    def set(self: &mut Document, path: &list[str], value: &Toml) -> Result[(), TomlError]
    def insert(self: &mut Document, path: &list[str], value: &Toml) -> Result[(), TomlError]
    def remove(self: &mut Document, path: &list[str]) -> Result[bool, TomlError]
def document(source: &[u8], bounds: &Limits) -> Result[Document, TomlError]
def document_text(text: &strview, bounds: &Limits) -> Result[Document, TomlError]
class TreeLimits
    max_depth: NonNegative[i64]
    max_nodes: NonNegative[i64]
    max_text_bytes: NonNegative[i64]
def tree_limits() -> TreeLimits
class CodecOptions
    limits: Limits

def codec_options() -> CodecOptions

    def reject(self, fault: std.serial.Fault) -> TomlError

    def start_object(self: &mut TreeEncoder) -> Result[(), TomlError]
```

## `std.units`

SI dimensions, prefixed and common units, physical constants, and dimension-aware square roots, sums and trigonometry over `Quantity`. Errors: `MathError`, `RangeError`. [Reference](units.md).

```text
dimension Mass("kg")
dimension Length("m")
dimension Time("s")
dimension Current("A")
dimension Temperature("K")
dimension Amount("mol")
dimension Luminosity("cd")
dimension Area = Pow[Length, 2]
dimension Volume = Pow[Length, 3]
dimension Wavenumber = One / Length
dimension Velocity = Length / Time
dimension Acceleration = Length / Pow[Time, 2]
dimension Frequency = One / Time
dimension Force = Mass * Acceleration
dimension Pressure = Force / Area
dimension Energy = Force * Length
dimension Power = Energy / Time
dimension Momentum = Mass * Velocity
dimension Action = Energy * Time
dimension Density = Mass / Volume
dimension MassFlowRate = Mass / Time
dimension VolumeFlowRate = Volume / Time
dimension DynamicViscosity = Pressure * Time
dimension KinematicViscosity = Area / Time
dimension SurfaceTension = Force / Length
dimension HeatFlux = Power / Area
```

## `std.url`

Strict RFC 3986 absolute URL parsing and formatting without normalization, component-aware percent encoding, and query pairs. Errors: `UrlError`. [Reference](url.md).

```text
enum UrlError
    LimitExceeded | MissingScheme | MissingHost | InvalidByte(i64) | InvalidEscape(i64) | InvalidHost(i64) | InvalidPort(i64) | InvalidUtf8 | Allocation(AllocError)
enum Component
    Userinfo | Segment | Path | Query | QueryPart | Fragment
class Url
    scheme: str
    userinfo: Option[str]
    host: Option[str]
    port: Option[i64]
    path: str
    query: Option[str]
    fragment: Option[str]
    def to_string(self) -> Result[str, UrlError]
class Pair
    key: str
    value: str
def parse(text: &strview, max_bytes: NonNegative[i64]) -> Result[Url, UrlError]
def encode_bytes(source: &[u8], component: Component) -> Result[Bytes, UrlError]
def decode_bytes(source: &[u8]) -> Result[Bytes, UrlError]
def encode(text: &strview, component: Component) -> Result[str, UrlError]
def decode(text: &strview) -> Result[str, UrlError]
def query_pairs(query: &strview) -> Result[list[Pair], UrlError]
def query_text(pairs: &list[Pair]) -> Result[str, UrlError]
```

## `std.uuid`

UUID values, canonical text and network bytes, random v4 and timestamp-prefixed v7 generation. Errors: `ParseError`, `BytesError`, `SecretsError`, `RangeError`. [Reference](uuid.md).

```text
class Uuid
    def as_u64_pair(self) -> (u64, u64)
    def compare(self, other: &Uuid) -> i64
    def is_nil(self) -> bool
    def is_rfc_variant(self) -> bool
    def version(self) -> Option[u8]
    def unix_milliseconds(self) -> Option[u64]
    def write_bytes(self, target: &mut Bytes, offset: i64) -> ()
    def to_bytes(self) -> Result[Bytes, BytesError]
    def to_string(self) -> Result[str, BytesError]
def nil() -> Uuid
def from_u64_pair(high: u64, low: u64) -> Uuid
def parse(text: &strview) -> Result[Uuid, ParseError]
def from_bytes(source: &[u8]) -> Result[Uuid, ParseError]
def v4_from[R: Reader](source: &mut Source[R]) -> Result[Uuid, SecretsError]
def v4() -> Result[Uuid, SecretsError]
def v7_from[R: Reader](at: &Timestamp, source: &mut Source[R]) -> Result[Uuid, RangeError | SecretsError]
def v7() -> Result[Uuid, RangeError | SecretsError]
```

## `std.xml`

Bounded UTF-8 XML event readers and validating stream writers, without DTDs or external entities. Errors: `XmlError`. [Reference](xml.md).

```text
enum Fault
    Syntax | UnexpectedEnd | InvalidName | InvalidCharacter | InvalidUtf8 | InvalidReference | UnknownEntity | DuplicateAttribute | MismatchedEnd | DoctypeForbidden | UnsupportedDeclaration | DepthExceeded | InputTooLarge | OutputTooLarge | TokenTooLarge | TooManyAttributes | InvalidState | Stopped | Allocation(AllocError) | Stream(StreamError)
class XmlError
    fault: Fault
    offset: i64
class Limits
    max_depth: NonNegative[i64]
    max_input: NonNegative[i64]
    max_output: NonNegative[i64]
    max_token: Positive[i64]
    max_attributes: NonNegative[i64]
def limits() -> Limits
class Attribute
    name: str
    value: str
enum Event
    Declaration(Option[bool]) | Start(str, list[Attribute]) | Empty(str, list[Attribute]) | End(str) | Text(str) | CData(str) | Comment(str) | ProcessingInstruction(str, str) | Eof
class Reader[R]
    inner: R
    def offset(self) -> i64
    def next(self: &mut Reader[R]) -> Result[Event, XmlError]
def reader[R](inner: R, bounds: &Limits) -> Result[Reader[R], XmlError]
class Writer[W]
    inner: W
    def offset(self) -> i64
    def write(self: &mut Writer[W], event: &Event) -> Result[(), XmlError]
    def finish(self: &mut Writer[W]) -> Result[(), XmlError]
def writer[W](inner: W, bounds: &Limits) -> Result[Writer[W], XmlError]
```
